name: @loaders.gl/schema
description: Table format APIs for JSON, CSV, etc...

scripts.pre-build: npm run build-bundle && npm run build-bundle-dev && npm run generate-json-schema
scripts.generate-json-schema: node ../../scripts/generate-json-schema.mjs --schema ./dist/geospatial-metadata-zod-schema.js --export GeoParquetMetadataSchema --output ./dist/geoparquet.schema.json --id https://unpkg.com/@loaders.gl/schema/geoparquet.schema.json --title 'loaders.gl GeoParquet metadata' && node ../../scripts/generate-json-schema.mjs --schema ./dist/geospatial-metadata-zod-schema.js --export GeoArrowMetadataSchema --output ./dist/geoarrow-metadata.schema.json --id https://unpkg.com/@loaders.gl/schema/geoarrow-metadata.schema.json --title 'loaders.gl GeoArrow field metadata'
